scenario.derivation: Median across GCC countries of the rise in food inflation from its 2019-2020 median to its 2021-2022 peak (FAOSTAT, same series). The adverse scenario ramps year-on-year food inflation up by this amount, linearly over 12 months, on top of the baseline forecast. The policy-response scenario applies a chosen mitigation share to the same shock. Both are hypothetical illustrations, not predictions or measured policy effects.
